title: Resilience & Balance Calculator: stress, energy, personal space
subtitle: A plain, gentle check-in — no heavy jargon, with small steps for today.
seoDescription: Free resilience calculator by period load, fatigue, and focus. Quick or 30-question deep quiz with specific answers and practical tips — in your browser.
heroDescription: Stress, tiredness, and quiet don't need complicated language. This tool helps you see where you stand — and suggests small steps that feel human.

sections.heading: What this calculator does
paragraphs: You set the season you're in, how tired you feel, and what's on your mind — then pick a quick or full quiz.
Questions cover pressure, rest, boundaries, and quiet — in everyday language.
The report shows a balance score, short insights, and small practical tips.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Fill the setup, choose quiz length, and answer with a clear progress bar.
Save to history (expand on the home grid) or download a result card.
Use the result as a gentle compass — not a label.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: It's easy to miss rising stress and fatigue until they grow.
Plain language makes patterns easier to see without panic.
One small step today beats a perfect plan waiting for tomorrow.

benefits.title: Clean language
benefits.description: No heavy clinical jargon or awkward translations.

benefits.title: Two lengths
benefits.description: A quick check or a full ~30-question assessment.

benefits.title: Practical tips
benefits.description: Small recommendations that feel doable today.

faq.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
faq.answer: No. It's everyday common-sense support — not a substitute for professional care.

faq.question: What if my score is low?
faq.answer: It's a signal to pause and pick one small step — not a verdict on who you are.

faq.question: Is data stored on a server?
faq.answer: No. Everything runs and saves locally in the browser.
